clinics.credentials: HA Thailand: listed as 'บำรุงราษฎร์ อินเตอร์เนชั่นแนล' (Bangkok, private) with Advanced HA (ขั้นก้าวหน้า), accredited 23 May 2025 to 22 May 2029, per HA Thailand open-data accreditation dataset (data as of 31 August 2026, file updated 3 September 2026), checked 30 October 2026. JCI: hospital site states first JCI accreditation in Asia in 2002, 7th reaccreditation in 2024, plus Certificates of Distinction for heart failure and breast cancer programs in 2025. JCI directory not reachable (HTTP 403 on 30 October 2026), so JCI status is as claimed on the hospital site. Also claimed on site: Global Healthcare Accreditation 2017 and 2024, College of American Pathologists 2016, Thailand Quality Class 2008. Main building opened 1997; 580 inpatient beds; over 620,000 international patients a year; listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand. MoPH facility licence number: not published on the pages read.
clinics.publishedPrices: Check-up package prices are published only as an image or PDF on the check-up packages page (program names such as Comprehensive, Executive, Holistic, Vitality Plus Cancer Genes; prices 'valid until 31 December 2026', per person, doctor fee included); the figures could not be read as text, so none are quoted here. Surgical package prices (LASIK, knee, cardiac) were not seen on the pages read. Estimates are described as 'a possible range of costs only' and exclude medicines, complications and ICU days.

booking.channels: Main line +66 2066 8888 (24 hours); outpatient appointments +66 2011 2222; third-party payor +66 2011 2289; emails admission@bumrungrad.com, ipdoffice@bumrungrad.com, opdpatient@bumrungrad.com, VOB@bumrungrad.com (insurance); inquiry form at bumrungrad.com/en/contact-us/inquiry; online booking at bumrungrad.com/en/book-appointment; teleconsultation via 'Bumrungrad Anywhere'; no WhatsApp or LINE listed. International referral offices listed at bumrungrad.com/en/contact-us/international-referral-offices.
booking.consult: Written estimate on request before care; costs of high-cost treatment are discussed before care begins; itemized bills on request. Consultation fee and response time not published.
booking.deposit: Full deposit required for all procedures including CT, MRI and PET; initial deposit based on the estimate for general medicine admissions; during admission expenses are updated every 3 days and additional deposit may be requested; excess deposit refunded after the procedure. Insured patients must pay a full deposit if no guarantee letter arrives within 48 hours of admission. Cash, cards, Alipay, WeChat, wire transfer, Western Union and emailed e-payment links accepted; credit-card refunds take 3 to 4 weeks; cash refund of a card payment carries a 2 to 3 percent commission plus 7 percent VAT.
booking.languages: Over 130 interpreters (languages not listed); site in English, Thai, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Burmese, Khmer, Bengali, German and others.
booking.includes: Medical Coordination Office described as a complimentary service for international patients.

Prof. Dr. Chatchai Kunavisarut DDS MSc, Dr. Peerapat Kaweewongprasert DDS MSD FICD, Dr. Wanvadee Shewinvanakitkul DDS MSD (orthodontist), Dr. Kittichote Boonsri DDS MSc (implants), Assist. Prof. Dr. Boworn Klongnoi DDS MD, and others; the site says the team includes American Board and Thai Board certified specialists but does not match certifications to names. No Thai Dental Council registry lookup was performed.
clinics.credentials: Not a hospital, so not on the HA list (checked HA Thailand open-data accreditation dataset (data as of 31 August 2026). JCI: site states 'Thailand's first internationally accredited JCI center, since 2012' and a 100 percent score on its latest survey (year not shown). JCI directory not reachable (HTTP 403 on 30 October 2026), so JCI status is as claimed on the hospital site. ISO 9001:2015 by Intertek claimed. Branches at Siam Paragon, EmQuartier, Phuket (Patong) and Chiang Mai. Founded year and clinic licence number not stated.
clinics.publishedPrices: Prices in THB at 1 USD = 36 THB from the fees page, 'package rates applicable till 31 October 2026': single implant fixture THB 35,000 to 70,000 ($972 to $1,944) plus implant crown THB 25,000 ($694); All-on-4 or ProArch full jaw from THB 290,000 ($8,056); zirconia crown THB 20,000 to 21,000 ($556 to $583); IPS e.max veneer THB 16,000 to 17,000 ($444 to $472); root canal THB 11,000 to 17,000 ($306 to $472); Zoom whitening THB 9,500 ($264); consultation free; panoramic X-ray THB 1,400 ($39); 3D CT THB 5,500 to 10,500. A THB 150 to 250 per-visit sterilization fee is charged separately. Tables on the page are inconsistent in places.

booking.channels: Phone +66 2 692 4433 or +66 2 694 6400; mobile and WhatsApp +66 83 272 2235; LINE @bidcdental; email contact@bangkokdentalcenter.com; enquiry form at bangkokdentalcenter.com/dental-clinics-contacts/dental-bangkok-enquiry/.
booking.consult: Dentist check-up and consultation listed as free; treatment plan after exam; complex cases may cost more. Deposit terms not published.
booking.includes: Warranty (Bangkok clinic only): crowns, bridges and dentures 2 years; porcelain veneers and inlays 1 year; implant fixtures 5 years; implant prosthetics 2 years. Requires check-ups every 6 to 12 months; no refunds; a failed first implant is replaced free but bone grafts are charged.
booking.languages: English and Thai; Japanese and Chinese sites linked.

clinics.name: Bangkok Smile Dental Group
clinics.district: Bangkok (multiple branches: Sukhumvit Soi 5, Asok, Silom, Phra Khanong, Ari, Bang Na and others)
clinics.namedDoctors: Site names Dr. Meghna Burad, Dr. Benyarat Pangsrisomboon, Dr. Arpisha Dhonavanik and Dr. Nattakan Nirattaradorn without individual credentials. No Thai Dental Council registry lookup was performed.
clinics.credentials: Not a hospital, so not on the HA list. Site claims ISO 9001:2008 certification (an old standard version; no year given) and no JCI. Branch structure: the Phuket branch (Sea Smile) runs a separate site. Founded year and clinic licence number not stated.
clinics.publishedPrices: Prices in THB at 1 USD = 36 THB from the price list page (exchange-rate note dated 25 September 2026): single implant from THB 55,000 ($1,528) per tooth, Straumann Roxolid THB 80,000 to 85,000 ($2,222 to $2,361); porcelain-fused-to-metal crown THB 12,000 to 13,000 ($333 to $361); zirconia crown THB 18,000 to 20,000 ($500 to $556); e.max veneer THB 11,000 to 13,000 ($306 to $361); All-on-4 from THB 270,000 per jaw ($7,500), Straumann THB 320,000 ($8,889); Zoom whitening promotion THB 9,000 ($250). Promotions shown with a 31 December 2026 end date. Root canal and consultation prices not listed; all prices described as estimates confirmed after a treatment plan.

booking.channels: Phone +66 2 105 4288; email contact@bangkoksmiledental.com; LINE; online contact form; 'free online consult'. No WhatsApp listed on the main site.
booking.consult: Free online consultation; promotions require advance reservation by email and cannot be combined. Deposit terms not published.
booking.includes: All-on-4 implants guaranteed 5 years; All-on-4 acrylic bridge 6 months; other warranty terms not stated.
booking.languages: Site in English, Thai, Chinese and Japanese.

clinics.name: Thantakit International Dental Center
clinics.district: Bangkok (Huai Khwang, New Petchburi Road; second office at All Seasons Place, Wireless Road)
clinics.namedDoctors: Dr. Thiti Sirikrai (MSc Orthodontics, Saint Louis University, USA; Invisalign Diamond Provider); Dr. Thara Sirikrai (Certificate in Implant Dentistry, New York University; Vice President, Thai Association of Dental Implantology); Dr. Piyaorn Janevittayaphan and Dr. Chinda Numkarunarunrote (Higher Graduate Diplomas, Mahidol University). Thai Dental Council board status not shown. No registry lookup was performed.
clinics.credentials: Not a hospital, so not on the HA list. No JCI or ISO claim on site. Site states founded 1945 and describes itself as Thailand's longest established dental center. Clinic licence number not stated.
clinics.publishedPrices: Prices in THB at 1 USD = 36 THB from the price page (no effective date; page footer 2026): single implant with zirconia crown THB 65,000 to 105,000 ($1,806 to $2,917) by brand; All-on-4 THB 340,000 to 440,000 ($9,444 to $12,222); e.max or zirconia crown THB 25,000 ($694); e.max veneer THB 18,000 ($500); root canal THB 11,000 to 17,000 ($306 to $472); Zoom whitening THB 12,000 ($333), promotion THB 9,900; consultation THB 1,000 to 2,000 ($28 to $56); panoramic X-ray THB 1,400. A 10 percent discount for cash or bank transfer applies to implants, crowns, veneers and orthodontics but not to agent bookings.

booking.channels: Head office +66 2 718 0777 and +66 80 309 8008; All Seasons Place +66 2 685 3444; WhatsApp wa.me/66803098008; LINE @thantakitdental; enquiry form on site; email obfuscated.
booking.consult: Initial consultation required, THB 1,000 to 2,000; deposit terms not published; cash, cards and bank transfer accepted.
booking.includes: Warranty: titanium implant fixtures 5 years; implant prosthetics, crowns, bridges and porcelain veneers 2 years; requires recall visits at least every 6 months; excludes accidents, gum disease, work by other dentists and travel costs.

clinics.name: Dental Hospital Bangkok (Sukhumvit 77, formerly Sukhumvit 49)
clinics.namedDoctors: Not named on the site; it states 95 dental specialists and 70 dental assistants. No Thai Dental Council registry lookup was performed.
clinics.credentials: Not on the HA hospital list under a dental hospital name (checked HA Thailand open-data accreditation dataset (data as of 31 August 2026). No JCI, HA or ISO claim on site. Site states it opened in 1990 at 88/88 Sukhumvit 49 and relocated on 1 March 2018 to a six-storey building at Sukhumvit 77 (T77 community) with 34 treatment rooms, an operating room and admitting rooms; it describes itself as a 'private modern dental clinic'. The site's https certificate is misconfigured, so content was read over plain http on 30 October 2026. Licence number not stated.
clinics.publishedPrices: Not published on its site. The site states Thais and non-Thais are charged the same fees and that cash and credit cards are accepted with no card surcharge.

booking.channels: Phone +66 2 092 2000; patient relations +66 2 092 2011 to 2016; email dental@dhbkk.com; hours Monday to Sunday 09:00 to 20:00 with 24-hour emergency on call. No WhatsApp, LINE or online form seen.
booking.consult: First visit includes oral exam, panoramic X-ray or CT and treatment plan, then referral to specialists; fee not stated. Deposit terms not published.
booking.languages: English site and Japanese page; 60 percent of patients stated to be foreigners.

clinics.credentials: Not a hospital, so not on the HA list. No ISO or JCI claim on its own site (the parent Bangkok Smile site claims ISO 9001:2008). Zoom Best Practice award 2023 mentioned. Founded year and clinic licence number not stated.
clinics.publishedPrices: Prices in THB at 1 USD = 36 THB from the fees page (exchange-rate note dated 25 September 2026): single implant from THB 55,000 ($1,528) Neo Biotech, from THB 65,000 ($1,806) AstraTech or Zimmer, THB 80,000 to 85,000 Straumann; porcelain crown THB 12,000 to 13,000 ($333 to $361); zirconia crown THB 18,000 to 20,000; e.max veneer THB 11,000 to 13,000; All-on-4 from THB 270,000 per jaw ($7,500); Zoom whitening promotion THB 9,000. One All-on-4 promotion was marked valid only to 30 September 2025. Root canal and consultation prices not listed.

booking.channels: Phone +66 2 105 4288 (shared Bangkok Smile line); WhatsApp wa.me/66639697655; email dentist@thaidentalcenter.com; appointment and 'free consult' forms on site; Facebook. No LINE listed.
booking.consult: Free online consultation offered; deposit terms not published.
booking.includes: Guarantee: crowns, bridges and porcelain veneers 2 years; composite fillings 6 months; dentures 3 years; implant fixtures 5 years (excluding bone grafts); implant crowns 2 years. Requires 6-monthly recall; excludes tobacco-related damage and work by other dentists; refunds decided case by case.

clinics.name: Rutnin Eye Hospital
clinics.namedDoctors: Not named on the pages read; the doctor directory is a JavaScript search that returned no names to automated reading. Site states more than 39 ophthalmologists with degrees from Thailand, Canada and the United States. Founder Professor Dr. Uthai Rutnin MD FACS. Thai Medical Council checkmd lookup returned HTTP 403 on 30 October 2026, so doctor registrations were not verified there.
clinics.credentials: HA Thailand: listed as 'จักษุรัตนิน' (Bangkok, private, small specialty hospital) with no accreditation level and no dates (ไม่มีขั้น), per HA Thailand open-data accreditation dataset (data as of 31 August 2026, file updated 3 September 2026), checked 30 October 2026. No JCI, HA or ISO claim on the site pages read. Site states over 60 years of experience (Instagram handle references 1964). MoPH licence number not published.
clinics.publishedPrices: Not published on its site in text form; the Package and Promotion page showed no prices to automated reading on 30 October 2026.

booking.channels: Phone +66 2056 3333; fax +66 2056 3311; email contact@rutnin.com; LINE lin.ee/9sZ4aoc; online booking at rutnin.com/en/appointment/step-1.php; outpatient hours Monday to Saturday 08:00 to 20:00, Sunday 08:00 to 19:00, public holidays 08:00 to 17:00. No WhatsApp listed.
booking.consult: Not published; no dedicated international patient page.
booking.languages: Site in English, Thai, Arabic, Khmer and Burmese.
